version.promotionalText: Рабочий чат сотрудников Prime Green Clinic: каналы, личные сообщения и треды.

review.notes:
Prime Team is an internal messaging app for employees of Prime Green Clinic (Kazakhstan). Accounts are created by the clinic's administrator; there is no self sign-up.

How to sign in:
1. Open the app — the site address app.primegc.kz is already filled in. Tap "Продолжить" (Continue).
2. Tap "Войти" (Sign in). The company login page opens in a secure browser window.
3. On the login page switch to the tab "Логин и пароль" (Login and password) — the first tab, "ЭЦП", is for Kazakhstan digital signatures — and enter the demo account credentials provided above.

The UI is in Russian.

The app is a modified version of the open-source project Raven (AGPL-3.0) by The Commit Company and is not affiliated with them.

User-generated content (Guideline 1.2): the app is not open to the public. Every account is a clinic employee created and managed by the clinic's administrator, who can remove messages, channels and users and disable accounts at any time. Employees can delete their own messages and leave channels. Concerns about content are handled by the clinic administration (info@primegc.kz).
